note: Call discover(category) for the contents of any of these, then describe(name) for detail on one item. Nothing here is in your system prompt — you are meant to pull only what you need.

categories.name: surfaces
categories.what: The machines and services in this system and how to reach each one.

categories.name: routes
categories.what: HTTP endpoints on the owner's Mac agent, read from its live route table.

categories.name: tools
categories.what: The tools the production voice agent actually ships with.

categories.name: devices
categories.what: Physical and virtual devices reachable right now, with live status.

categories.name: hardware
categories.what: The pendant and bridge chips: memory, I/O, storage, radio, power.

categories.name: owner
categories.what: The person this is for: what they actually said, what they scheduled, what is remembered about them, and what they asked for and did not get. Every other category describes machines.

categories.name: backlog
categories.what: What earlier rounds already proposed, and what became of each one. Restating one of these is a wasted round; building past it is not.

categories.name: granted
categories.what: What the orchestrator has already given you this run.
